data.content_ref: inline:Make attack-defeater warrants themselves subject to the grounded fixpoint before they are allowed to defeat an attack. A registered warrant w that targets an attack edge e becomes effective only if w is accepted in the grounded extension of the framework that contains all warrants but not their defeats; then compute a second pass where those accepted warrants' defeats are applied. This avoids self-defeating warrants and keeps determinism because the two passes are each deterministic fixpoints. Criticism: circular dependencies between warrant acceptance and defeat application may require a careful stratification; a warrant that is only accepted because of its own defeat is rejected.
